notes:
A round of editor fixes so nested lists and zoom behave the way you'd expect — your indentation stays put, and zooming into a bullet works properly again.

**Fixes & polish**

- **Pressing Enter at the start of a bullet or line keeps your structure intact.** It now adds an empty line above and leaves your item — and everything nested under it — exactly where it was, instead of pushing your text a level deeper. (Fix #592.)
- **Zooming into a bullet works properly again.** You can create deeper-nested children while zoomed in; you can no longer accidentally outdent a block *out of* the item you've zoomed into; and the **Up arrow** moves through your list correctly. (This also fixes the Up arrow sometimes jumping straight to the note title in ordinary lists.) (PRD Addendum 20; fix #593.)

**Under the hood**

- Added a zoom conformance test suite (PRD Addendum 20 §T) with a guard-safety check, so future changes to the editor's shared key handlers can't silently regress zoom again. (#594.)
